title: Jeff's Farm -  Jill's Dairy — EN/IT/DE 2
style: Zimbabwean Mbira Folk, Urban Grooves, Acoustic Storytelling Ballad]
lyrics:
[singer A]
Before the paperwork, before the visa
Before Australia knew the name
There was a farm in Zimbabwe
And a man who ran it straight

[singer B]
Four in the morning. The dairy doesn't wait.
She knew every name. The rhythm was hers.
You knew where you stood with Jill — solid ground.
She didn't say it twice. She didn't need to.

[singer A]
Jeff was up before the light came over
He walked the rows before the workers arrived
Not because he didn't trust them
But because that's what a farming man does in his life

[melodic interlude]

[singer B]
Quattro di mattina. La latteria non aspetta.
Conosceva ogni nome. Il ritmo era suo.
Sapevi dove ti trovavi con Jill — terra solida.
Non lo diceva due volte. Non ne aveva bisogno.
Alcune persone tengono le famiglie unite in silenzio.
Jill lo faceva in silenzio.

[singer A]
Jeff's farm
Where the workers came back every morning
Jeff's farm
Where respect was a thing you earned and kept
Jeff's farm
Where the red dust tells no stories
That the people there already know

[singer B]
Jills Molkerei
In den Stunden bevor die Welt aufwacht
Jills Molkerei
Wo die echte Arbeit in der Dunkelheit erledigt wird
Jills Molkerei
Wo Gewissheit eine Morgengewohnheit ist
Und die Kühe nach Hause kommen
Weil Jill da ist

[singer A]
They left the farm.
That's a hard sentence.
But they brought it with them.
You always do.
You bring the way you walk the rows at sunrise.
You bring the way you know when something's right.
You bring Jeff's farm.
Even in Australia.
Even now.

[singer B]
The dairy didn't fail. The family didn't fail. These things are connected.
La latteria non ha fallito. La famiglia non ha fallito. Queste cose sono collegate.
Die Molkerei hat nicht versagt. Die Familie hat nicht versagt. Diese Dinge sind verbunden.

[singer A]
Jeff's farm
Still somewhere in how they carry themselves
Jeff's farm
Jill's dairy in the early morning hours
Jeff's farm
In how Joel knows what a good man looks like
Jeff's farm
In everything Kerri is
